title: GB/Z 185 x MCP x A2A x SPIFFE x SAEE Crosswalk v0.1
title_zh: GB/Z 185 × MCP × A2A × SPIFFE × SAEE 交叉映射 v0.1
purpose: Route existing identity, description, discovery, interaction and tool-invocation responsibilities to upstream standards before proposing any Digital Biosphere or SAEE implementation.

source_scope.gbz185: Official title and status metadata for GB/Z 185.1 through GB/Z 185.7 were inspected. Full-text clause-level conformance was not assessed.
source_scope.mcp: Stable specification 2026-07-28 server tools semantics were inspected.
source_scope.a2a: Current A2A specification Agent Card, skills, capabilities and protocol-version semantics were inspected.
source_scope.spiffe: Current SPIFFE identity, SVID and Workload API specifications were inspected.
source_scope.saee: Canonical SAEE capability inventory and MCP surface were inspected from the SAEE canonical engineering repository.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第1部分：总体架构

mapping.MCP: Protocol component for context exchange and tool exposure; not asserted equivalent to the national guidance architecture.
mapping.A2A: Protocol component for Agent discovery and interaction; not asserted equivalent to the national guidance architecture.
mapping.SPIFFE: Workload identity component; not an Agent-interconnection architecture.
mapping.SAEE: Evaluation and evolution-intelligence consumer only; does not replace the architecture.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第2部分：身份码

mapping.MCP: No Agent identity-code ownership inferred from the inspected tools specification.
mapping.A2A: Agent Card carries Agent metadata; no equivalence with GB/Z identity-code semantics is claimed.
mapping.SPIFFE: Defines SPIFFE ID for workload identity; conceptual identity input only, not an asserted GB/Z implementation.
mapping.SAEE: May consume an identity reference as evaluation context; external identity binding remains missing.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第3部分：身份管理

mapping.MCP: Authorization can constrain the tool set returned to a request; this is not identity management ownership.
mapping.A2A: Declares authentication and authorization requirements in Agent Cards; it does not by itself operate identity lifecycle.
mapping.SPIFFE: Workload API distributes and updates SVIDs and trust bundles; this is the primary inspected workload-identity lifecycle source.
mapping.SAEE: Does not issue identity, credentials or permissions. Identity issuer or binding changes route to reassessment.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第4部分：智能体描述

mapping.MCP: Server and tool metadata describe exposed tool interfaces.
mapping.A2A: Agent Card describes identity metadata, endpoints, capabilities, authentication requirements and skills.
mapping.SPIFFE: Identifies workloads; it is not an Agent capability-description format.
mapping.SAEE: Consumes declared description only as untrusted context unless separately bound and verified.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第5部分：智能体发现

mapping.MCP: tools/list discovers the current request-scoped tool set, not peer Agents in general.
mapping.A2A: Agent Card and well-known discovery are the primary inspected Agent-discovery surface.
mapping.SPIFFE: Provides cryptographic workload identity material, not Agent discovery.
mapping.SAEE: Does not create a Registry or discovery service.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第6部分：智能体交互

mapping.MCP: Supports client-server context and tool interaction; it is not treated as a complete Agent-to-Agent protocol.
mapping.A2A: Defines messaging, tasks, streaming and protocol-versioned Agent interaction.
mapping.SPIFFE: Can authenticate workloads participating in an interaction but does not define task semantics.
mapping.SAEE: May evaluate bounded interaction evidence; it does not execute or authorize interaction.

gbz185_series.title_zh: 人工智能 智能体互联 第7部分：智能体工具调用

mapping.MCP: Stable 2026-07-28 tools/list, tools/call and notifications/tools/list_changed are the primary inspected tool interface and change signal.
mapping.A2A: Agent Cards describe skills and capabilities; A2A is not treated as a replacement for MCP tool invocation.
mapping.SPIFFE: Can authenticate the calling workload; it does not describe tool schemas or calls.
mapping.SAEE: May consume a versioned tool-manifest digest as evaluation context; it does not scan or execute tools.

responsibility_routing.question: Who defines Agent description and discovery?
Who defines tool listing, calling and tool-list change signals?
Who decides whether an old evaluation is stale after a relevant dependency changes?
responsibility_routing.additional_guidance: Agent Baseline Check remains a deferred SAEE candidate, not an implemented tool.

adjacent_sources_not_owned_by_this_cross.role: Execution observation input; PR 445 and PR 447 remain open proposals and are not adopted fields in this crosswalk.
Signed-statement and receipt transparency primitive; signature or receipt does not establish statement truth.
